Using Exchange AutoDiscover feature to perform SSRF attack

Unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted URLs targeting Exchange autodiscover endpoint

IP addresses scanning for ProxyShell vulnerable devices: 3.15.221.32, 194.147.142.0/24
